svg.aria-label: Budlum Leaf plate P09 screen cost whole-area bend and seal
svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P09 · THE SCREEN COST, THE WHOLE-AREA BEND AND THE SEAL
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P09 · THE SCREEN COST, THE WHOLE-AREA BEND AND THE SEAL
The network reduces screen power from 2.02 W to 0.98 W. The 80 x 160 x 4.00 mm prism bends smoothly over its whole area to R 25.5 mm (no hinge, no crease), with a dual-lip IP68 seal.
A · WHO PAYS FOR THE SCREEN · five terms, and the network's share

g.text: 1 · the photons · the light the eye needs
luminance, a dark interface, the picture level
3 · the radio · the class of the session
C0b display lists, the cache, the delta
1 Hz on a static page, 144 Hz on motion
it must answer with no network
the network can reach about 0.98 W of 2.02 W: it covers about half of the cost of the surface working,
not by paying joules but by shaping what the screen has to do.
the photons can never come from the network: a lumen is a photon at a retina, and the panel is the transducer.
the energy that the eye receives must be emitted inside the eye's field, by the surface that the eye is looking at.
two currencies: joules are spent in the hand, and meters are spent on the network. the wallet pays meters only.
the photon-honest interface: every interface declares an energy budget per screen minute, and the surface shows the meter.
the lights stay honest under the claim rule: a runtime claim names the luminance, the picture level and the session class.

svg.text: B · THE WHOLE-AREA BEND · R 25.5 mm (no hinge, no crease)

g.text: no book fold, no hinge, and no localized R 2.0 mm crease line
the 160 mm span wraps smoothly over an 80 mm arc at R_n = 25.5 mm
each 0.43 mm polycarbonate + AMOLED face bends around its own axis
4 polymer-gel battery layers (0.45 mm) slide on 3 silicone layers
battery collector foil strain = 0.38% (below 0.90% Al yield limit)
3.50 mm shear slip per side is absorbed in the 4.20 mm end pockets
5 000 wraps at R 25.5 mm + 50 000 bends at R 70 mm (gates B-1..10)

svg.text: C · THE UNIFORM SYMMETRIC STACK · every layer bends around its own neutral plane

g.text: 35 µm silicone OCA + 35 µm Ag-Cu mesh
110 µm LTPO backplane and emissive stack
4 x 0.45 mm polymer-gel + 3 x 0.05 mm silicone
80 x 160 x 4.00 mm (R 3.20 corner, r 0.80 edges)
flexes over whole 80 mm bend zone
dual-lip FKM elastomer collar on battery cap
because there is no R 2.0 mm book fold, the cover stays a uniform 150 µm polycarbonate across the whole face
the qualification test: 5 000 wraps at R 25.5 mm and 50 000 gentle bends at R 70 mm (-20 °C to +60 °C)
the pass: zero dead pixels, residual bow under 0.15 mm, and >99% capacity after 1 000 wraps (>85% after 5 000)
optical profilometry across the 76.4 x 156.4 mm face must show surface waviness below 15 µm (gate B-4)
the upright B module (40 x 32 x 4.00 mm) sits on the top edge outside the central bend zone (gate B-10)
the bend is a whole-body elasticity law (HARDWARE/12), never a mechanical hinge

svg.text: D · THE (<15 µm, n=1.585) (+) OPTICAL SEAM AND REV L.5.0

g.text: the 80.0 x 160.0 x 2.20 mm body splits in (+) cross into 4 tiles (40 x 80 mm)
12 um n=1.585 phenyl-fluorosilicone lip matches polycarbonate (R < 0.0001%)
any quadrant detaches by hand in under 3 s (EU 2023/1542 Article 11)
central Titanium Cruciform (+) Hub + 8 micro-dovetail pins (<2.5 um Z-step)
24 bipolar N52H magnets + 64 gold micro-leaf contacts + IP68 seal
portless body charges on any Qi / Qi2.2 wireless pad (15-25 W)
the ONLY USB Type-C port lives inside the 90°-bent stem of the B module
Q43 the (+) seam: 12 um n=1.585 optical lip + Ti hub (zero scratch/line)
Q44 the tiles: 4 x (40 x 80 x 2.20 mm) ISO 10993 PC + T-OLED + PDLC
Q45 the screen cost: 0.85 W Zero-CPU total draw (>14.1 h on 12.0 Wh)
Q46 the bend law: whole-area wrap to R 25.5 mm (0.38% strain, B-1..10)
Q47 the battery: 4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh LLZO solid-state (<=36.2 C, 0 HF)
Q48 the module: 90°-Bent-Stem B (stem above edge, ring ON screen, 4 edges)
the gates: MEC-19..22, B-1..10, ENR-11..21, and MON-1..20
